Select IC50 activity rows for human Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1' and target organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
